title: Fictional Turkish document retrieval dataset
quality_claim: This small fictional fixture makes no claim about general Turkish retrieval quality; the labels were not independently adjudicated.
source_schema: documents.json keeps id/title/text. Answerable queries keep id/category/text/relevant_ids and add group_id/split. Unanswerable queries are in a separate file with empty relevant_ids.

split.development: 14 answerable families (56 queries) and 11 unanswerable queries
split.default: The evaluator uses development queries by default. The full 40-document corpus remains searchable for every split.
split.leakage_control: All query records use group_id and split. Close unanswerable intents share the corresponding answerable family group and split: shipment (ua-03/ua-04), address (ua-05), return (ua-06), branch_hours (ua-07/ua-10), leave (ua-08), password (ua-09), and library (ua-12). Keep each group intact when splitting. The remaining unanswerable intents have unique group IDs.
split.held-out: 8 answerable families (32 queries) and 9 unanswerable queries

categories: Answerable labels include exact phrase, uppercase/Turkish casing, ASCII spelling (where marked), paraphrase, and suffix/inflection changes. Some intents intentionally have multiple relevant documents.
limitations: Unanswerable queries are in a separate file because the current evaluator requires nonempty relevant_ids.
Labels were authored alongside the documents for this draft, not independently adjudicated.
This fixture is for workflow exploration and does not support a general quality claim.
held_out_policy: Reserved for a final untouched evaluation. No held-out benchmark is included in the development results.
